<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_2223823_apollo_0.HospitalRoleUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>HospitalRoleUtils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var HospitalRoleUtils = Class.create();
HospitalRoleUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
    },

	getUsersWithRole: function(roleName) {
        var userIds = [];
        var grUserRole = new GlideRecord('sys_user_has_role');
        grUserRole.addQuery('role.name', roleName);
        grUserRole.addQuery('user.active', true);
        grUserRole.query();
        
        while (grUserRole.next()) {
            userIds.push(grUserRole.getValue('user'));
        }
        
        return 'sys_idIN' + userIds.join(',');
    },

    type: 'HospitalRoleUtils'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>ridhwik.jangid</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-05 10:29:33</sys_created_on><sys_id>ec7858ba47505b10273a565a516d43c0</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>HospitalRoleUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Apollo-Hospitals" source="x_2223823_apollo_0">87c1422693c89b507b3a7c5efaba1008</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Apollo-Hospitals">87c1422693c89b507b3a7c5efaba1008</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_ec7858ba47505b10273a565a516d43c0</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>ridhwik.jangid</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-05 10:30:02</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
